test_rules.causality: Sharing evidence/harnesses is not sharing historical timing controls. Bundle effects are bundle effects; individual serving contributions require ablation.
test_rules.component: Both cards sequentially; inherited numerical and per-family compiler/resource gates; current screening default >=10% primary median saving with gap above larger range and regression veto. Exact formulas stay source-bound.
test_rules.cumulative_eligibility: Original standalone verdicts and frozen gates remain unchanged. A new owner-requested cumulative experiment may include members that missed only performance usefulness/noise thresholds. State uncertainty; preserve numerical, compiler/resource, no-regression, lifecycle and route requirements. Never count overlapping gains twice.
test_rules.efficiency: Record the actual metric and its baseline/uncertainty. Storage, allocation, instruction or traffic savings do not establish energy or serving-latency savings. A CPU-only design is not a runnable bundle member.
test_rules.failures: No automatic retry or owner-budget expansion; consumed operations remain consumed. Retain primary failure and cleanup evidence.
test_rules.identity: Real production producer/reader witnesses for both 8-row and 16-row paths, including candidate absence in control; absent evidence fails closed.
test_rules.native: Mac stdlib only; framework compilation/tests in the declared device-free native CPU sandbox. Reproduce baseline artifacts before candidate resource claims.
test_rules.power: Fresh paired controls at matching235W, re-authenticated when preparing the packet; no power mutation. Earlier300W timings are historical only.
test_rules.review: Owner requested Opus 5.5 before sprint signoff. Use one consolidated bounded review of the frozen sprint evidence; Fable is not required.
test_rules.serving: Frozen comparator: 3 observations/case, 2% noise floor, <=10% spread, <=2% completion-token delta, >=3% balanced speed-ratio gain and no case regression. All answers and warm-cache bounds pass. No relaxed gate for bundles.
